providers.name: Galaxy, procedurally generated by scripts/generate-procedural-textures.mjs (no third-party material)

review.note: Checked live (2026-08-26): USGS's Mimas catalog has no controlled global photo mosaic, only an airbrush shaded-relief map, a pictorial map and a control-point network — none is a real photographic texture. Replaced 2026-08-27's fallbackColor-only rendering with a procedural texture parameterized on the real Herschel crater (spans ~1/3 of Mimas's diameter, ~6 km central peak) — one oversized basin with a central peak, plus moderate general cratering.
